title: Thoryn provisioning workflow configuration
description: SSO-3719 (epic SSO-3304) — `.thoryn/workflow.yaml`: the RUN-TIME configuration of the reusable provisioning workflow thoryn-io/thoryn-cli/.github/workflows/provisioning.yml. The stub a repository keeps (`.github/workflows/thoryn-provisioning.yml`) carries the JOB-SHAPE knobs as `with:` inputs (environments, runner, issuer, cli-version, timeout); this file carries what the jobs do at run time. Committed, DATA, validated by `thoryn provision workflow check`. Unknown keys are refused: a knob that is not here is a product gap to report, never a script to write — the identity (the job's OIDC token) and the review gate (the job's GitHub environment) must stay inside the reusable workflow.

provider.description: The forge whose job token is the repository's identity. `github_actions` only today: a Forgejo trust exists on the hub (oauthy converge ADR Amendment 3) but `thoryn login --connection` cannot exchange a Forgejo job token yet — a recorded product gap.

files.description: The provisioning files to plan (on a pull request) and apply (on the default branch), in order — one or many: a production file and sandbox files. Default: .thoryn/provision.yaml with .thoryn/connection.json.

file.description: Relative path of a thoryn.io/provision/v1 file.

connection.description: Relative path of the connection contract that signs in for this file. Default: connection.json beside the file (the layout the Thoryn GitHub App seeds).

env.description: Extra environment variables for the CLI — ALLOW-LISTED NAMES ONLY: THORYN_* (the CLI's own variables and the {{env.NAME}} placeholders a provisioning file reads), not one the reusable workflow sets itself (THORYN_ISSUER, THORYN_HUB, THORYN_FIX_REQUEST, THORYN_CI_PLAINTEXT_TOKENS, …), never credential-shaped (*_SECRET, *_PASSWORD, *_TOKEN, *_KEY). Values are exported to the CLI's steps, never evaluated as shell.

fixRequest.description: Upload the SSO-3710 fix request (`thoryn-provision-request`) when a job is red on a missing right, so the Thoryn GitHub App can name the fix on the check run.

consentUrl.description: SSO-3723 — the base URL of the Thoryn GitHub App's browser consent. A red job then prints `To fix — Option 2, in the browser: <consentUrl>/github/consent/run/<owner>/<repository>/<run_id>` (resolvable by run: the consent id the App mints after the run is unknowable to the job) and the fix request carries it as `options.consentUrl`. Exported to the CLI as THORYN_CONSENT_URL when the reusable workflow's `consent-url` input is empty. Configuration, never guessed from the issuer. Empty ⇒ Option 1 (the CLI commands) alone.

apply.description: Apply-time toggles. Removals are NEVER on by default.

prune.description: Pass --prune: remove owned resources the file no longer declares.

destroy.description: Run `thoryn provision destroy` after a successful apply (an ephemeral fixture, e.g. an e2e sandbox).

confirm.description: The workspace slug confirming production-plane removals (the SSO-2413 gate); empty when nothing on the production plane is ever removed.
